name: Monthly Performance Trend Report
description: Monthly performance, capacity planning, OOM tracking, health scorecard. Account: 0 | Cluster: aks-cargoestms-prod

rawConfiguration.text:
# Monthly Account Health Scorecard
Thresholds: Green = healthy, Yellow = warning, Red = critical. Throughput and Apdex show month-over-month comparison (up = good). Response time and error rate use absolute thresholds (lower = better).

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS 'RPM' FROM Transaction SINCE 1 month ago COMPARE WITH 1 month ago
SELECT average(duration) AS 'Avg (s)' FROM Transaction SINCE 1 month ago COMPARE WITH 1 month ago
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) AS 'Error %' FROM Transaction SINCE 1 month ago COMPARE WITH 1 month ago
SELECT apdex(duration, 0.5) AS 'Apdex' FROM Transaction SINCE 1 month ago COMPARE WITH 1 month ago

SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS 'RPM', average(duration) AS 'Avg (s)', percentile(duration, 95) AS 'P95 (s)', percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) AS 'Error %', apdex(duration, 0.5) AS 'Apdex' FROM Transaction FACET appName SINCE 1 month ago LIMIT 40

widgets.title: Top 5 Services at Risk (Highest Error Rate)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) AS 'Error %', average(duration) AS 'Avg (s)', rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS 'RPM' FROM Transaction FACET appName SINCE 1 month ago LIMIT 5

SELECT average(cpuCoresUtilization) AS 'Avg CPU %', average(memoryUtilization) AS 'Avg Mem %', max(cpuCoresUtilization) AS 'Peak CPU %', max(memoryUtilization) AS 'Peak Mem %' FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'aks-cargoestms-prod' AND cpuCoresUtilization IS NOT NULL FACET containerName SINCE 1 month ago LIMIT 5

widgets.title: Throughput Trend (This Month vs Last Month)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM Transaction SINCE 1 month ago COMPARE WITH 1 month ago TIMESERIES 1 day

widgets.title: Response Time Trend (This Month vs Last Month)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(duration) FROM Transaction SINCE 1 month ago COMPARE WITH 1 month ago TIMESERIES 1 day
SELECT count(*) AS 'OOMKills' FROM InfrastructureEvent WHERE event.reason = 'OOMKilling' AND clusterName = 'aks-cargoestms-prod' SINCE 1 month ago
SELECT uniqueCount(podName) AS 'Pods > 90% Mem' FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'aks-cargoestms-prod' AND memoryUtilization > 90 SINCE 1 month ago
SELECT uniqueCount(containerName) AS 'Throttled' FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'aks-cargoestms-prod' AND cpuCoresUtilization > 95 SINCE 1 month ago
SELECT latest(restartCount) - earliest(restartCount) AS 'Restarts' FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'aks-cargoestms-prod' FACET containerName SINCE 1 month ago LIMIT 1

pages.name: 2. Capacity Planning & Right-Sizing
pages.description: CPU and Memory requested vs actual usage, efficiency analysis

rawConfiguration.text:
## Capacity Planning and Right-Sizing Analysis
| Utilization Band | Status | Action |
|---|---|---|
| Below 30% | Over-provisioned | Reduce resource requests to save cost |
| 30% - 70% | Healthy | No action needed |
| 70% - 85% | Watch | Monitor closely, may need scaling |
| Above 85% | At Risk | Increase limits or scale out to prevent OOM/throttling |

widgets.title: CPU Right-Sizing: Requested vs Actual (All Services)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(cpuRequestedCores) AS 'CPU Requested (cores)', average(cpuUsedCores) AS 'Avg CPU Used (cores)', max(cpuUsedCores) AS 'Peak CPU Used (cores)', average(cpuUsedCores) / average(cpuRequestedCores) * 100 AS 'CPU Util %', average(cpuLimitCores) AS 'CPU Limit (cores)' FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'aks-cargoestms-prod' AND cpuRequestedCores > 0 FACET containerName SINCE 1 month ago LIMIT 40

widgets.title: Memory Right-Sizing: Requested vs Actual (All Services)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(memoryRequestedBytes) / 1048576 AS 'Mem Requested (MB)', average(memoryWorkingSetBytes) / 1048576 AS 'Avg Mem Used (MB)', max(memoryWorkingSetBytes) / 1048576 AS 'Peak Mem Used (MB)', average(memoryWorkingSetBytes) / average(memoryRequestedBytes) * 100 AS 'Mem Util %', average(memoryLimitBytes) / 1048576 AS 'Mem Limit (MB)' FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'aks-cargoestms-prod' AND memoryRequestedBytes > 0 FACET containerName SINCE 1 month ago LIMIT 40
SELECT average(cpuCoresUtilization) FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'aks-cargoestms-prod' FACET containerName SINCE 1 month ago TIMESERIES 1 day LIMIT 10
SELECT average(memoryUtilization) FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'aks-cargoestms-prod' FACET containerName SINCE 1 month ago TIMESERIES 1 day LIMIT 10

widgets.title: CPU Efficiency: Services by Utilization Band

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT uniqueCount(containerName) FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'aks-tms-prod' AND cpuRequestedCores > 0 FACET CASES(WHERE cpuCoresUtilization < 30 AS 'Over-provisioned (<30%)', WHERE cpuCoresUtilization >= 30 AND cpuCoresUtilization < 70 AS 'Healthy (30-70%)', WHERE cpuCoresUtilization >= 70 AND cpuCoresUtilization < 85 AS 'Watch (70-85%)', WHERE cpuCoresUtilization >= 85 AS 'At Risk (>85%)') SINCE 1 month ago

widgets.title: Memory Efficiency: Services by Utilization Band

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT uniqueCount(containerName) FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'aks-tms-prod' AND memoryRequestedBytes > 0 FACET CASES(WHERE memoryUtilization < 30 AS 'Over-provisioned (<30%)', WHERE memoryUtilization >= 30 AND memoryUtilization < 70 AS 'Healthy (30-70%)', WHERE memoryUtilization >= 70 AND memoryUtilization < 85 AS 'Watch (70-85%)', WHERE memoryUtilization >= 85 AS 'At Risk (>85%)') SINCE 1 month ago

SELECT average(cpuCoresUtilization) AS 'Avg CPU %', max(cpuCoresUtilization) AS 'Peak CPU %' FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'aks-tms-prod' AND cpuRequestedCores > 0 FACET containerName SINCE 1 month ago LIMIT 40

SELECT average(memoryUtilization) AS 'Avg Mem %', max(memoryUtilization) AS 'Peak Mem %' FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'aks-tms-prod' AND memoryRequestedBytes > 0 FACET containerName SINCE 1 month ago LIMIT 40

pages.name: 3. OOM & Stability Analysis
pages.description: OOMKill events, memory pressure, restart correlation

rawConfiguration.text:
## OOM Kills, Near-OOM Events and Container Stability
Correlates memory pressure with container restarts to identify services at risk of instability.

**Restart Count Notes:** Positive values = container restarts during the month. Negative values = the service was redeployed onto fresh pods during the month (the previous pod had accumulated restarts, the new pod started at 0). Negative values typically indicate a deployment occurred and the service is now running cleanly.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'OOMKills' FROM InfrastructureEvent WHERE event.reason = 'OOMKilling' AND clusterName = 'aks-cargoestms-prod' SINCE 1 month ago
SELECT uniqueCount(event.involvedObject.name) AS 'Pods' FROM InfrastructureEvent WHERE event.reason = 'OOMKilling' AND clusterName = 'aks-cargoestms-prod' SINCE 1 month ago
SELECT uniqueCount(containerName) FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'aks-cargoestms-prod' AND memoryUtilization > 90 SINCE 1 month ago
SELECT latest(restartCount) - earliest(restartCount) AS 'Restarts' FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'aks-cargoestms-prod' FACET containerName SINCE 1 month ago LIMIT 1
SELECT count(*) FROM InfrastructureEvent WHERE event.reason = 'OOMKilling' AND clusterName = 'aks-cargoestms-prod' FACET event.involvedObject.name SINCE 1 month ago TIMESERIES 1 day

widgets.title: Peak Memory % for Services with Restarts

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT max(memoryUtilization) FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'aks-cargoestms-prod' AND restartCount > 0 FACET containerName SINCE 1 month ago TIMESERIES 1 day LIMIT 10
SELECT latest(restartCount) - earliest(restartCount) AS 'Restarts' FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'aks-cargoestms-prod' FACET containerName SINCE 1 month ago LIMIT 15

SELECT max(memoryUtilization) AS 'Peak Mem %', average(memoryUtilization) AS 'Avg Mem %', average(memoryLimitBytes) / 1048576 AS 'Mem Limit (MB)', max(memoryWorkingSetBytes) / 1048576 AS 'Peak Mem Used (MB)', latest(restartCount) - earliest(restartCount) AS 'Restarts (Monthly)' FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'aks-cargoestms-prod' AND memoryUtilization IS NOT NULL FACET containerName SINCE 1 month ago LIMIT 40

SELECT count(*) FROM InfrastructureEvent WHERE clusterName = 'aks-cargoestms-prod' AND event.reason IN ('OOMKilling', 'Evicted', 'BackOff', 'FailedScheduling', 'Unhealthy', 'FailedMount', 'FailedCreate', 'Killing') FACET event.reason SINCE 1 month ago

widgets.title: K8s Events by Service and Type

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Events' FROM InfrastructureEvent WHERE clusterName = 'aks-cargoestms-prod' AND event.reason IN ('OOMKilling', 'Evicted', 'BackOff', 'FailedScheduling', 'Unhealthy', 'FailedMount', 'FailedCreate', 'Killing') FACET event.involvedObject.name, event.reason SINCE 1 month ago LIMIT 40

### External Service Calls
Shows time spent in external HTTP calls per transaction. External duration is the portion of total response time spent waiting for downstream services.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(externalDuration) AS 'Avg External (s)' FROM Transaction WHERE externalDuration IS NOT NULL SINCE 1 month ago COMPARE WITH 1 month ago

widgets.title: Max External Duration in Single Txn (s)

SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE span.kind = 'client' AND http.url IS NOT NULL SINCE 1 month ago COMPARE WITH 1 month ago

widgets.title: Top 10 Transactions with Highest External Duration

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(externalDuration) AS 'Avg External (s)', average(duration) AS 'Avg Total (s)', count(*) AS 'Calls' FROM Transaction WHERE externalDuration IS NOT NULL FACET name, appName SINCE 1 month ago LIMIT 10

widgets.title: Top 10 External Hosts by Volume and Latency (Spans)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Calls', average(duration.ms) AS 'Avg (ms)', percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS 'P95 (ms)' FROM Span WHERE span.kind = 'client' AND http.url IS NOT NULL FACET server.address, appName SINCE 1 month ago LIMIT 10

pages.name: 5. K8s Infrastructure & Restarts
pages.description: Container restarts per service, HPA scaling, CPU and Memory

rawConfiguration.text:
## Container Restarts, HPA Scaling, CPU and Memory
Restart counts: latest(restartCount) minus earliest(restartCount) per service within the month.

**Negative values** indicate the service was redeployed during the month. The old pod had accumulated restarts, and the new pod started fresh at 0. This is normal for services with regular deployments and indicates improved stability.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(restartCount) - earliest(restartCount) AS 'Restarts' FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'aks-cargoestms-prod' FACET containerName SINCE 1 month ago LIMIT 20

widgets.title: Restart Detail by Service and Pod

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT max(restartCount) AS 'Restarts (This Pod)', latest(restartCount) AS 'Current Count' FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'aks-cargoestms-prod' FACET containerName, podName SINCE 1 month ago LIMIT 40
SELECT latest(desiredReplicas) FROM K8sHpaSample WHERE clusterName = 'aks-tms-prod' FACET displayName SINCE 1 month ago TIMESERIES 2 hours LIMIT 20

SELECT min(currentReplicas) AS 'Min Replicas', max(currentReplicas) AS 'Max Replicas', max(currentReplicas) - min(currentReplicas) AS 'Scale Range', max(maxReplicas) AS 'HPA Max Limit', latest(desiredReplicas) AS 'Current Desired' FROM K8sHpaSample WHERE clusterName = 'aks-tms-prod' FACET displayName SINCE 1 month ago LIMIT 20

widgets.title: HPA Scale Range by Service (Higher = More Scaling Activity)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT max(currentReplicas) - min(currentReplicas) AS 'Scale Range' FROM K8sHpaSample WHERE clusterName = 'aks-tms-prod' FACET displayName SINCE 1 month ago LIMIT 20
SELECT average(cpuCoresUtilization) FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'aks-cargoestms-prod' FACET containerName SINCE 1 month ago TIMESERIES 1 day LIMIT 20
SELECT average(memoryUtilization) FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'aks-cargoestms-prod' FACET containerName SINCE 1 month ago TIMESERIES 1 day LIMIT 20

widgets.title: Peak CPU, Memory and Restarts by Service

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT max(cpuCoresUtilization) AS 'Peak CPU %', average(cpuCoresUtilization) AS 'Avg CPU %', max(memoryUtilization) AS 'Peak Mem %', average(memoryUtilization) AS 'Avg Mem %', latest(restartCount) - earliest(restartCount) AS 'Restarts (Monthly)' FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'aks-cargoestms-prod' FACET containerName SINCE 1 month ago LIMIT 40

## Database Performance
DB time from APM Transaction events (databaseDuration attribute). Query-level detail from Span events (requires distributed tracing). If Span queries are empty, verify distributed tracing is enabled on your agents.

pages.name: 7. Runtime Performance (Java / Node.js)
pages.description: Heap, GC, threads (Java) and event loop, RSS (Node.js)

rawConfiguration.text:
## Runtime VM Performance
Shows heap usage, garbage collection, and runtime-specific metrics.
- **Java services**: Heap, GC pause, thread count via JVM metrics
- **Node.js services**: Heap, GC pause, physical RSS, event loop via V8 metrics

Charts auto-filter by runtime. Java-only metrics are empty for Node.js services and vice versa.
Diagnostic query: `SELECT uniques(metricTimesliceName) FROM Metric WHERE appName = 'YOUR_APP' AND metricTimesliceName LIKE 'Memory/%' SINCE 1 day ago`

SELECT max(apm.service.memory.heap.used) / 1048576 AS 'Peak Heap MB', average(apm.service.memory.heap.used) / 1048576 AS 'Avg Heap MB' FROM Metric WHERE entity.guid IN ('NDUxNjIzN3xBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058NDgyNDI2MzYy','NDUxNjIzN3xBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058NDI3NDAyNzI4','NDUxNjIzN3xBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058NTIyNzg5MTEy','NDUxNjIzN3xBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058NDMxODIzNzUz','NDUxNjIzN3xBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058NDU4NzEwMTI0','NDUxNjIzN3xBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058NTMxNzM1Njc4','NDUxNjIzN3xBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058NDU4NzE3MzAz','NDUxNjIzN3xBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058NDI3NDAyODcz','NDUxNjIzN3xBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058NTMxNjgxMTg3','NDUxNjIzN3xBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058NDU4NzA5OTM5','NDUxNjIzN3xBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058NTIzMTA5MTM5','NDUxNjIzN3xBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058NDg1NjMxNTE4','NDUxNjIzN3xBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058NDIyMzQwMzk5','NDUxNjIzN3xBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058NTMxNzIxMjEx') FACET entity.name SINCE 1 month ago LIMIT 20

SELECT rate(sum(newrelic.timeslice.value), 1 minute) * 1000 FROM Metric WHERE metricTimesliceName LIKE 'GC/%' AND entity.guid IN ('NDUxNjIzN3xBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058NDgyNDI2MzYy','NDUxNjIzN3xBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058NDI3NDAyNzI4','NDUxNjIzN3xBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058NTIyNzg5MTEy','NDUxNjIzN3xBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058NDMxODIzNzUz','NDUxNjIzN3xBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058NDU4NzEwMTI0','NDUxNjIzN3xBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058NTMxNzM1Njc4','NDUxNjIzN3xBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058NDU4NzE3MzAz','NDUxNjIzN3xBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058NDI3NDAyODcz','NDUxNjIzN3xBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058NTMxNjgxMTg3','NDUxNjIzN3xBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058NDU4NzA5OTM5','NDUxNjIzN3xBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058NTIzMTA5MTM5','NDUxNjIzN3xBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058NDg1NjMxNTE4','NDUxNjIzN3xBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058NDIyMzQwMzk5','NDUxNjIzN3xBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058NTMxNzIxMjEx') FACET entity.name SINCE 1 month ago TIMESERIES 1 day LIMIT 20
